title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go; parity fixes and v1.140.0 bump
author: Anna Patel
release_notes: Unified SDK behavior for auth/retries and streaming across Python/TS/Go. Ergonomics improvements to streaming APIs, parity fixes for edge cases, and version bump to v1.140.0 for all SDKs.
description: Context: Multiple SDKs (python/typescript/go) had diverging behaviors for authentication retries and streaming ergonomics which caused inconsistent semantics in our client libraries and led to support tickets (SUP-881). This PR unifies the auth retry logic, standardizes streaming helper ergonomics, applies parity fixes discovered during cross-SDK audits, and performs a coordinated version bump to v1.140.0. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate auth token refresh + retry semantics across SDKs - [x] Expose ergonomic streaming helpers (async iterator in Python, async generator in TS, channel-based helper in Go) - [x] Fix parity issues: chunked event decoding, header propagation, and context cancellation propagation - [x] Update docs and CHANGELOG entries for each SDK - [x] CI green across python/ts/go suites Motivation: Customers expect identical behavior regardless of language. Previous subtle differences caused downstream errors (duplicate retries, missing token refresh under intermittent failures, and streaming handlers that required custom glue code). This PR reduces surface area for bugs and simplifies our support and examples. Implementation notes: - Introduced central retry strategy specification and shared test vectors (tests/test_retry_matrix.*) that each SDK mirrors. - Streaming ergonomics: added a small helper in each SDK that normalizes chunk framing and yields typed events; behavior is feature-flagged and defaults to ON for v1.140.0. - Auth changes: token refresh now follows the same retry/backoff semantics and will not duplicate in-flight refresh attempts (singleflight pattern). - Parity fixes: aligned header casing rules, fixed a bug in python where eof frames were ignored, and corrected Go context cancellation that previously leaked goroutines. Impact: Backwards-compatible in most cases; streaming helper is additive. Consumers who relied on previous internal streaming framing may need to opt out. See release_notes for guidance. Related: ENG-2456, ENG-2482. CI: python unit/integration, ts unit/e2e, go unit/integration. Merge: squash and merge after approvals.
